description: Business Central finance ledgers per company (book): companies, item ledger and G/L entries, G/L accounts, and the (unserved) Portal app_bc_entity_map. Business documents (orders, invoices, receipts, shipments and their lines, incl. their BC and Sage bindings) are declared once, in orders.json / purchasing.json; links here target those types and binding ids. BC is Production and read GET-only; the company is the lineage bc_<book> (manufacturing, distribution, consol). Renumbering: Portal SO/PO numbers are rewritten to the BC No. after drain (custom_fields.renumberedTo), and BC externalDocumentNumber echoes the customer PO (orders) or the Portal order number (invoices). Also the aged receivable/payable balances per party and the payment journal lines (Payment).

object_types.description: A payment line in a BC customer or vendor payment journal (customerPayments / vendorPayments): a receipt from a customer or a payment to a vendor, optionally applied to one posted invoice. Journal lines are unposted: BC removes a line from the journal when it posts it, so a captured line later marked missing_from_source was posted or deleted, never proven paid. Paid state of an invoice comes from the invoice (status, remaining_amount).

availability.reason: Only unposted payment journal lines: BC API v2.0 serves no posted payment (customer/vendor ledger entries are not published for these companies, plx-customer-portal@790256c inbound.ts:248-268); Portal app_order_prepayment is outside the reporting API allowlist. UNVERIFIED live until verify/live-checks/bc.ledgers.json passes.

object_types.description: Portal's identity bridge app_bc_entity_map: (entity_type, source_system portal|fm|sage, source_id) -> BC systemId + No. (+ echoed externalDocumentNumber), status LINKED|ARCHIVED|BLOCKED. It is the only verified Portal<->BC link for renumbered orders, POs and invoices; distribution clones encode the book in source_id ('{id}::distribution'). Until it is served, Portal<->BC links fall back to renumberedTo (verified) and number/externalDocumentNumber matches (leads). Its bindings and the entity-map joins (SalesOrder/PurchaseOrder/Product.bc_posted_as, SalesInvoice.posted_for_order) are declared and tested in ontology/schema/pending/bc_entity_map.json, which replaces this placeholder when loaded with include_pending.

availability.reason: app_bc_entity_map and every bc_* snapshot table are outside the reporting API allowlist.

evidence.note: app_bc_entity_map: unique (entity_type, source_system, source_id); source_system portal|fm|sage; bc_system_id, bc_number, bc_external_document_number; status LINKED|ARCHIVED|BLOCKED; no company column.
masterBookSliceId / shipmentBookSliceId: distribution clones use source_id '{id}::distribution' (shipments '{id}::manufacturing|::distribution'); the book is encoded in source_id, not a column.
After drain the gold SO order_number is rewritten to the BC document No.; custom_fields.renumberedTo keeps the BC No., fmOeNumber the earlier number.
Gold PO po_number is rewritten to the BC No.; custom_fields.renumberedTo / fmPoNumber keep both numbers.

link_types.name: posted_by_receipt
link_types.description: Ledger entry whose document No. is a posted receipt No. (same company). Document numbers of different document types can collide, so this stays corroborated, never verified.

link_types.name: posted_by_shipment
link_types.description: Ledger entry whose document No. is a posted sales shipment No. (same company): BC posts the item ledger entries (entry type Sale) of a sales order line on its posted shipment, and the cost of the invoiced quantity lands on that entry. Document numbers of different document types can collide, so this stays corroborated, never verified.

link_types.name: posted_by_credit_memo
link_types.description: Ledger entry whose document No. is a posted sales credit memo No. (same company): posting a credit memo Item line without a return receipt puts the goods back into inventory on an entry of type Sale and document type Sales Credit Memo, whose Cost Amount (Actual) is the returned goods' cost. A return posted through a return receipt carries the receipt's No. instead and is not linked here. Document numbers of different document types can collide, so this stays corroborated, never verified, and consumers read document_type first.
